CustomField.description: Total Refunded. Sum of the standard Refunded Amount (RefundedAmount) across every Gift Transaction under this Gift Commitment - i.e. funds returned to the funder (unspent, disallowed, or clawed-back award money) recorded as Gift Refund records. Maintained by the DLRS roll-up Grant Commitment Total Refunded. Cannot be a native roll-up summary because Gift Transaction is joined to Gift Commitment by lookup, not master-detail. Do not edit by hand. See docs/grant-reimbursement-rollups.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Funds returned to the funder, totalled from the Refunded Amount on this commitment's Gift Transactions. Calculated - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Total Refunded
